sentences.text: Coringasuchus is a genus of mesoeucrocodylian crocodyliform, a term for a specific group of crocodile relatives, that is possibly classified as a notosuchian.

Alexander Kellner and colleagues described the genus in 2009 after finding fossils, including cranial material, in the early Cenomanian-age Upper Cretaceous Alcântara Formation on Cajual Island in northeastern Brazil.
Coringasuchus belongs to the parent group Notosuchia.
It is also classified within the class Reptilia.
This animal lived during the Cenomanian stage, between 100.5 and 93.9 million years ago.
